source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2 defines risk for psi_1 and gives the one-arm lower bound; the real-data section reports n=9915, d=8196 and states its bootstrap/asymptotic-normal reference intervals may lack nominal coverage.

The paper derives finite-sample optimal ATE estimators and CIs under smoothness/shape restrictions with normal known-variance errors, then discusses feasible asymptotic inference when errors are unknown.
